outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative ex vivo photographic/fluorescence images of lungs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B is a bar chart of mean ICG fluorescence intensity with individual data points (blue and red dots) overlaid for each mouse.
Panel C shows histology/RNAscope images and spatial transcriptomics heatmap plots, not a bar/summary plot requiring individual points.
Panel D shows GSEA enrichment plots (line plots), which are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel E is a bar chart showing log2 fold change for multiple genes but displays only bars without any overlaid individual data points.
Panel F shows representative fluorescence and IHC images, not a plot of averaged data.
